authorization: Operator allows parameter-selection design runs only after separate pre-freeze margin diagnostic

ifAllFail: NO_D0_CANDIDATE; do not freeze anything, do not relax 2.0 margin; report negative grid.

notes: These are design candidates, never registered hypotheses or frozen parameters. Coverage of movement masks is an explicit 2-mask screen, not full 4096 dynamic histories. No v2 K1-K5 calibration allowed.
